official_findings.direct_payment: Contipark officially states that spontaneous direct payment is available through the Charge Assist app or website, operated by GreenFlux.
official_findings.registration: Direct payment is available without a charging card; a valid payment method is entered in Charge Assist.
official_findings.blocking_fee: Contipark states that it generally does not levy a blocking fee for Direct Payment charging sessions.
official_findings.parking_fee: Parking fees remain separate and may apply according to the specific parking facility.
official_findings.official_price_publication: No universal direct-payment kWh price was found on the public Contipark page; the applicable direct tariff must therefore be resolved at station/EVSE checkout level.

decision: Do not create a DE*CTP fallback tariff. Resolve each canonical EVSE through Contipark/GreenFlux direct-payment checkout or another station-level verifiable source. Preserve parking fees as separate site costs and do not fabricate a blocking fee.
